description: This file contains localization data and related functions for the Croatian (Bosnia and Herzegovina) culture, including date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype extensions for date manipulation, all tailored for the 'hr-BA' locale within the DateJS library.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date to the current time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a date object representing the start of the current day.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two dates, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Converts day name to its index number.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Converts month name to its index number.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name based on its offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone offset for a given timezone name.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of a date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares a date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if a date equals another date.

methods.name: between
methods.description: Checks if the date falls between two other dates.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks if the date is after another date.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Checks if the date is before another date.

methods.name: isToday
methods.description: Checks if the date is today.

methods.name: isSameDay
methods.description: Checks if the date is the same day as another date.

methods.name: addMilliseconds
methods.description: Adds milliseconds to a date.

methods.name: addSeconds
methods.description: Adds seconds to a date.

methods.name: addMinutes
methods.description: Adds minutes to a date.

methods.name: addHours
methods.description: Adds hours to a date.

methods.name: addDays
methods.description: Adds days to a date.

methods.name: addWeeks
methods.description: Adds weeks to a date.

methods.name: addMonths
methods.description: Adds months to a date.

methods.name: addYears
methods.description: Adds years to a date.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a specified amount of time based on a configuration object.

methods.name: getWeek
methods.description: Calculates week number of the date.

methods.name: getISOWeek
methods.description: Calculates ISO week number.

methods.name: setWeek
methods.description: Sets the week number for the date.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves the date to the nth occurrence of a specific day of the week.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves date to a specific day of the week.

methods.name: moveToMonth
methods.description: Moves date to a specific month.

methods.name: getOrdinalNumber
methods.description: Returns the ordinal number of the date.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation.

methods.name: setTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Sets the timezone offset.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the timezone.

methods.name: hasDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if daylight saving time is observed.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if currently in daylight saving time.

methods.name: getUTCOffset
methods.description: Returns the UTC offset string.

methods.name: getElapsed
methods.description: Returns the time elapsed since the date.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Converts the date to ISO string format.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the date.
